newsitem.title: UK: Hanson off as Kleinwort cuts to "hold".
newsitem.headline: Hanson off as Kleinwort cuts to "hold".

text.p: Shares in Hanson Plc dropped in heavy trading on Tuesday as analysts at Dresdner Kleinwort Benson cut the stock to "hold" from "buy," market sources said.
The stock, which has rallied from around 80p at the end of 1996, was down 2-1/2p at 92 by 1037 GMT in volume of 27 million shares.
Kleinwort analysts were not immediately available for comment.

Earlier Hanson said it would demerge its energy division on February 24 if shareholders gave the go-ahead at a meeting to be held on February 21. The former industrial conglomerate has already demerged its Imperial Tobacco and Millenium Chemical units. The forthcoming demerger of The Energy Group from Hanson's building materials business will complete a restructuring first announced in 1995.
